units.source_text: 头中将心中好笑，但装作不知，走到源氏公子躲着的屏风旁边，把屏风折叠起来，发出劈劈啪啪的声音。

en.t: The Captain found it amusing inwardly, but pretended not to know anything. He walked over to the screen where Prince Genji was hiding, folded it up, and made a sharp crackling sound.

units.source_text: 内侍虽然年老，还是一个善于逢迎男子的风骚女人。

en.t: Although the Naishi was old, she was still a flirtatious woman skilled at ingratiating herself with men.

units.source_text: 为两男争风吃醋而伤脑筋的事件，她经历得多。

en.t: She had experienced many troublesome incidents in which two men quarreled out of jealousy over her.

units.source_text: 虽然司空见惯，这回却也非常狼狈，生怕新来的那个男子将对源氏公子有所不利，甚是担心。

en.t: Though she was used to such things, this time she was terribly flustered, fearing that the newly arrived man might do something harmful to Prince Genji, and she was deeply worried.

units.source_text: 连忙起身，战战兢兢地拉住了这个男子。

en.t: She hurriedly rose and, trembling with fear, held the man back.
